title: ShellAtol Mod
description: This mod adds plenty of new stuff!
body:
This mod adds PLENTY of stuff. Here are the items:
![items](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a81ef05b8625d15136f8ce5e75b2c9241f1b4a0d.png)

Just to tell you, /sa is NOT an item. It is a command.
The SA folder item is Command-only and is the shellatol creative tab icon.
Here is what the SA block looks like:
![sa block](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a243f6afedb9b80ffdada7431646de0e19f3a40b.png)
Here are the portals (Shellatol and Shell):![Portals](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2f58af417a598fc74ee8a32d774b4f562d26c5fb.png)
And I just forgot to mention the Mona Lisa painting item, that has missing textures, and also the shellatol potions and side effect, the satol biome, and the advancement.

Made with [MCreator](https://mcreator.net/)
